info.name: E-Commerce & Inventory Management API - Test Suite
info.description:
Comprehensive Postman v2.1 Test Collection for the E-Commerce & Real-Time Inventory Management System Backend.

### Collection Variables:
- baseUrl: http://localhost:5000/api/v1
- customerToken, sellerToken, sellerBToken, adminToken, customerRefreshToken
- productId, categoryId, orderId

### How to Run via Postman Collection Runner:
1. Ensure MongoDB replica set is running and seeded (`npm run seed`).
2. Start the server (`npm run dev` or `npm start`).
3. In Postman, click on this collection and open the 'Run' tab (Collection Runner).
4. Keep the default execution order (Auth runs first to populate token variables).
5. Click 'Run E-Commerce & Inventory Management API'. All assertions will pass in sequence.

### How to Test the Concurrency Case (Race Condition on Last Item):
To verify that the atomic conditional decrement (`{ stock: { $gte: quantity } }, { $inc: { stock: -quantity } }`) strictly prevents overselling:
1. Seed the database (`npm run seed`) or create a product with `stock = 1`.
2. Open Postman Collection Runner or Newman in two concurrent terminal windows, or use an asynchronous script (e.g. `Promise.all([fetch(checkout), fetch(checkout)])`) with two different customer accounts.
3. Both customers add 1 unit of the item to their cart.
4. Trigger the `POST /orders` checkout simultaneously.
5. Result: Exactly one checkout will succeed with HTTP 201 Created. The other checkout will receive HTTP 409 Conflict with the message 'Insufficient stock'. Product stock will equal 0 and will NEVER drop to negative values.
